header: Three places that ask our customers, and what they got back
lead: Different questions, different scales, different sets of customers. We publish all three because the interesting part is that they disagree by less than half a point.
note: Figures read on 2 March 2026. None of the three lets us edit a review, and none of them has ever been paid by us. The two-hundred-odd customers who appear on more than one directory are counted twice across this row.
